title: ScenarioMetadata
description: Schema for scenario.json, written by Dev Test Evidence Capture into every session folder. This is the durable contract a future tool (e.g. a Claude Code skill) reads to discover a ticket, its scenarios, and their screenshots without needing the app itself.

ticketNumber.description: Original ticket number as entered by the user (pre-sanitization).

scenarioName.description: Original scenario name as entered by the user (pre-sanitization).

sessionStart.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was started (or first started, if later resumed).

sessionEnd.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was explicitly stopped. Null while the session is still Active or Interrupted.

screenshots.description: All screenshots captured in this session, ordered by sequenceNumber ascending.

sequenceNumber.description: 1-based chronological capture order. Immutable once assigned.

fileName.description: The final filename after any optional renaming (or the original numeric filename, e.g. 01.png, if renaming was skipped).

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this screenshot was captured.

note.description: Optional note the user typed when capturing this screenshot (what was done or observed). Omitted when no note was given.
